narrative.text:
I’ll replace native-property mutation with an explicit call-site observer, then add an import-only preflight to check every intended call target and measure trace volume. No native section or store constructor/open/read/write path will run in this round.

All 12 import-only controls reached `instrumentation-ready`; the descriptor checks and synthetic observer tests passed.

The measured budget is a warning, not a pass: weighting import capture across 42 native children gives **189.1 MiB**, or **205.1 MiB** with the existing non-trace allowance—above the 192 MiB filter threshold, before store work. Native execution must remain stopped. I won’t raise limits or add a new capture design.
